question: Where can I locate café within 130 kilometers when heading toward Miami Sun Hotel, Miami, FL starting at Cox Science Center and Aquarium, West Palm Beach, FL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.069796 26.669305)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.192179 25.776661)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.069796 26.669305)',4326)::geography, 130000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.069796 26.669305)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
